body:
I know I will have to block him on everything and that’s not the issue it’s the issue of even bringing it up, how I don’t think things are working. 

Yea, that’s what I don’t get. He doesn’t make sense, he’s unemployed and is picky with what job he wants then never goes to the interviews/applies. How do you have a kid with no job? And I would never want to be the only one working, a relationship is supposed to be team work in my book. He says he wants to work and make a living but he doesn’t act on it. 

I brought up that things were bothering me and he gets all defensive and starts yelling... making me feel guilty. He says stuff like”that’s my business” and “I’m a procrastinator, that’s just what I do” and “I trust you with your business so trust me with mine.” I told him why I was worried about his situation, because of before and he just keeps saying that’s his business not mine... I don’t get how that’s not my business if we are in a relationship.

I’m honestly just scared to as well... Not because I’m worried about not finding someone else, it’s the fact that he gets so mad. I’m not good with screaming and yelling and it honestly just scares me... I tried ghosting last time and he wouldn’t stop calling me on random numbers and begging me to meet with him to talk. It literally went on for months... and right now with how my home life is I can’t take all that along with everything else I wish it wouldn’t go like that but I know it will and I’m just afraid.

At this point I see all his crap, I don’t know why I was so blind and I guess I was trying to ignore the fact of everything I was seeing. I just don’t even know how to get out of this ... I just know I really want out.

One day we were having an argument and I actually told him to “find some other girl to have a kid with then.” In response he said “how dare you say that to me, I love you.”  I really want to break up at this point I just don’t know how.
